## How every exercise is solved

Each notebook follows the same discipline, established in the
[Preface](preface/index.qmd) case studies and kept throughout:

- **Question → data → EDA → methods → decision**, with every figure and
  table reproducible from the notebook itself.
- **Dual inference**: the classical parametric test or interval alongside a
  **randomization test, bootstrap interval, or simulation** (10,000+
  replicates, seed 2026). Where the two disagree, the notebook says so —
  usually a signal of skewness or a small sample.
- **Datasets from [lock5stat.com](https://www.lock5stat.com/datasets3e/)**,
  archived under `data/`; where the book prints only summary statistics,
  the reconstruction is documented.
- **Rendered automatically** on every push via GitHub Pages, powered by
  Quarto and Jupyter.

## Source {.unnumbered}

All exercises come from Lock, Lock, Lock Morgan, Lock & Lock,
*Statistics: Unlocking the Power of Data*, 3rd edition (Wiley, 2021).
Datasets are published at [lock5stat.com](https://www.lock5stat.com/).
Source notebooks live in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/math4mad/Lock5Stat-by-AI) — every
page above is generated from a `.qmd` in `chapters/`, `phase2/`, or
`preface/`.
